---
name: Site not working
about: Paste Typer doesn't type correctly on a specific site
title: "[Site] "
labels: site-adapter
---

**Site URL**
<!-- Remove private document/account IDs and query tokens. A site name is enough
when the page is behind a login. -->


**What happened**
<!-- Nothing typed / partial text / wrong characters / page rejected the input -->

**Expected and actual result with harmless test text**
<!-- For example, type PT-test-483920 and report the exact result. Never post a
real password, verification code, clipboard contents, or private document. -->

**Field/editor type**
<!-- Input / textarea / rich text / code editor / canvas / split boxes.
Include the editor package/version if known. -->


**How you invoked it**
<!-- Popup / right-click menu / floating UI -->


**Chrome version and OS**

**Paste Typer version and enabled state**
<!-- Open chrome://extensions. Note Web Store vs unpacked installation. -->

**Page and tab state**
<!-- Already open before an update? Does refreshing fix it? Foreground tab,
background tab, or minimized browser? -->

**Embedded editor access**
<!-- Is the editor inside an iframe? Was its site allowed in the popup? -->


**Console errors, if any**
<!-- Right-click → Inspect → Console -->

**Small public reproduction, if possible**
<!-- Link a minimal HTML/editor example. If you cannot share the page, describe
the steps and what changes after focus. Remove private URLs from screenshots. -->
